Subject: Activation commitment: org onboarding sprintcard — networking & credentials

Hi Alex / Samira —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per our conversation I put together the first-pass mutual action plan (attached) and a short onboarding sprintcard so we can lock dates for credentials, org setup, and the networking window. High-level asks and proposed timeline below — please confirm or flag changes by EOD Monday so we can finalize the MAP.

Redwood deliverables (we own these):
- Create HealthDex org seed in Redwood Console and invite two admin users (target: 2026-03-24)
- Issue initial API keys + ephemeral token rotation script (target: 2026-03-25)
- Provide IP allowlist guidance and sample CIDR ranges to validate (target: 2026-03-24)
- Coordinate VPC peering/testing window and runbook (proposed: 2026-04-05 to 2026-04-07)

HealthDex deliverables (we need from you):
- Share primary networking contact and public tenant CIDR(s) for peering & firewall (target: 2026-03-23)
- Provide completed security questionnaire excerpt where required for provisioning (target: 2026-03-24)
- Confirm target go-live for the evaluation sandbox (suggested: 2026-04-14)

Risks / open questions:
- If your CIDR overlaps with our staging ranges we may need NAT solutions — flag early.
- Ephemeral-key rotation frequency — we can default to 24-hr keys but can change based on your security policy.

Attaching the draft MAP and a short runbook snippet for VPC peering. I also added a HubSpot note (HS-4392).

Next step: Alex — can you confirm the networking contact and whether the April peering window works?

Thanks,
Lauren

Alex / Samira —

Appreciate the quick reply. I've updated the MAP draft and laid out an actionable sprintcard below (owners and firm dates). Please review; once you confirm we will: 1) seed the org, 2) issue keys, and 3) kick the peering prep.

Sprintcard (summary)
- 2026-03-23: HealthDex -> Share networking contact + CIDR (Owner: HealthDex / Alex)
- 2026-03-24: Redwood -> Create org seed, share invitation links (Owner: Lauren)
- 2026-03-24: Redwood -> Deliver IP allowlist guidance + sample ranges (Owner: Jordan)
- 2026-03-25: Redwood -> Issue API keys and deliver ephemeral-rotation script (Owner: Jordan)
- 2026-03-29: HealthDex -> Confirm firewall rules + provide any required NAT details (Owner: HealthDex / Samira)
- 2026-04-05 to 2026-04-07: Networking window for VPC peering and smoke tests (Owner: Neha)
- 2026-04-14: Target evaluation sandbox go-live (Owner: joint)

Notes / technical specifics:
- Org setup: We'll invite two admin users you designate. Once accepted, we'll create a single dedicated project for the evaluation that isolates logs and metrics.
- API keys: We'll issue an initial pair (read-only eval key + admin key). The ephemeral rotation script is a small bash snippet that hits our token endpoint; Jordan will share a sample and recommended cron. If you prefer 12-hr TTL (security ask), we can set that by default — confirm and we'll adjust.
- IP allowlist: Please provide external-facing IP/CIDR list for the firewall; we will provide a recommended /28 sample if you need a narrow range.
- VPC peering: Our runbook assumes BGP-less static routes and an AWS transitive-standby; Neha will confirm exact route table changes and timings.

Links: MAP draft and the HS ticket are in the related links (see HubSpot HS-4392).

If that plan looks good I will lock dates and send calendar invites for the peering window and a 30-min pre-runbook review with Neha and Samira.

Thanks,
Lauren
